LanguageData.Gun_Arisaka_Type_38_RWP.label: Arisaka Type 38
LanguageData.Gun_Arisaka_Type_38_RWP.description: A battle rifle from the early 20th century, the Arisaka Type 38 features a bolt-action mechanism with a 5-round internal magazine. Known for its reliability and strong construction, this weapon delivers moderate damage with commendable accuracy. Ideal for mid-range engagements, it's a testament to historical precision and sturdy design.
